Application Data.NAME: Smith & Co. Leatherworks
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Co. Leatherworks specializes in the retail sale of high-quality leather goods, including handbags, wallets, belts, and luggage. We pride ourselves on offering a curated selection of handcrafted items sourced from skilled artisans and reputable manufacturers. Our operations include an online store as well as a brick-and-mortar location where customers can experience our products firsthand. In addition to retail sales, we also provide custom leatherwork services, catering to individual client requests for personalized designs and repairs. Our commitment to exceptional customer service and craftsmanship sets us apart in the leather goods market.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a water leak from the ceiling caused damage to 15 leather handbags displayed in the store. The estimated loss was $1,200.00. The claim was filed, processed, and closed successfully by the insurance provider with the total loss amount reimbursed.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security guard during store hours, locked display cases for valuable items, and motion sensor alarm system.
